claim_boundary: One bounded coding smoke test; not a general quality, latency, or cost claim.

release_smoke_gate.quality: all three arms complete and pass the same external acceptance once
release_smoke_gate.attempts: one model attempt and zero host retry per arm
release_smoke_gate.oververification: 0.6.0-beta.1 has zero unnecessary same-generation verification repeats after the verifier actually ran; a single 126/127 runner recovery is counted separately
release_smoke_gate.beta1_direct_behavior: no delegation, no unnecessary state or workflow documents, no background work, and no unnecessary repeated verification
release_smoke_gate.cache_comparability: compare observed normalized cost only when exact cache hit/write exposure differs by no more than 5 percentage points; otherwise retain observed cost but gate on cache-neutral cost with all input charged at the uncached rate
release_smoke_gate.versus_beta9: single-sample wall time, Raw Token, and selected cost basis: at least two deltas are no more than +3% (equivalent/not worse) and none is more than +10%
release_smoke_gate.versus_direct: wall time and the selected cost basis are each no more than 15% worse; Raw Token is reported separately and is not an additional hard gate
release_smoke_gate.infrastructure: an auth, quota, provider, transport, host, or unclassified execution failure is not a product failure; one explicitly authorized replacement may replace only the affected cell while retaining the original
